dashboards.name: Target missing market data
dashboards.description: Today's started VWAP/TMX/PART/LINE/IIS/SDMA/DLP targets with no row in target_strike, among those activated in the last 30 seconds. Real-time only. Below: targets whose current target_state is activated, counted per instance (the trader column).

datasets.name: missing_md
datasets.raw_qsql: {[] dataCheck:(select distinct id_target, sym from target where date=.z.D, algo in (`VWAP`TMX`PART`LINE`IIS`SDMA`DLP), t_start<.z.T) except (select distinct id_target, sym from target_strike where date=.z.D); idTgts:exec distinct id_target from dataCheck; activeIds:exec distinct id_target from target_state where date=.z.D, time>.z.T-00:00:30.000, state=`activated, id_target in idTgts; select id_target, trader, basket, sym, side, size, otype, limit_price, algo, ordstart:t_start from target where date=.z.D, id_target in activeIds}[]

datasets.name: activated_by_trader
datasets.raw_qsql: {[] live:exec id_target from (0!select last state by id_target from target_state where date=.z.D) where state=`activated; `targets xdesc 0!select targets:count distinct id_target by trader from target where date=.z.D, id_target in live}[]
